summary: Practise threat assessment, safe movement planning and incident response for humanitarian field operations. Explore the course and strengthen field procedures.
lede: Humanitarian field security training helps aid staff assess personal threats and plan field movements. For security focal points, field managers and programme staff, it develops practical skills in creating threat assessments and risk registers, preparing journey plans and movement check-ins, briefing colleagues on duty of care, and recording incidents and escalation decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for humanitarian staff who assess threats, approve or coordinate field movement, maintain duty of care, or respond when a security incident disrupts operations.
modules: Field Security Reporting and Action Planning
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with humanitarian programme or field operations is useful. No prior security-management qualification or programming experience is assumed. Exercises use written templates and may be completed on paper or in a spreadsheet.
